blurb: Arrowood Golf Course is a par-71, 6,721-yard golf course designed by Ted Robinson Jr, located in Oceanside near San Diego. The course features four sets of tees to suit all skill levels and a challenging final four holes called The Quandary. The greens are a blend of Poa annua and Bermuda grass, kept firm and fast, with a potential two-club wind affecting play.
extraNote: Two guests per golf cart; personal golf cart incurs $20 fee
